files.docs/devbox/cli.md:
# Devboxes

Cloud dev machines for Acme, run on Coder.

| Task | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Create a devbox | `acme devbox create -n <name> [--branch <branch>]` |
| List your devboxes | `acme devbox list` |
| Start a stopped devbox | `acme devbox start <name>` |
| Open a shell | `acme devbox ssh <name>` |

`acme devbox` wraps the Coder CLI (`coder create`, `coder start`, `coder ssh`) and adds Acme's workspace setup.
